Requires a workspace API token; Zapier OAuth credentials are rejected. Adds a document, URL, embed, or section divider to a content tab (tabId, or the room's first content tab when omitted) at position (the end when omitted); the items after it move one place.

document: a document from your library. Every audience link gets its own tracked copy, and on verify-any and Restricted links the copy follows the link's access check. Documents count toward the plan's documents-per-room limit.

url: a URL from your library (urlId), or a new one (url and title), which is added to your library too.

embed: a page from a supported provider, shown inside the room. Other providers return 400 EMBED_PROVIDER_NOT_SUPPORTED.

section: a labeled divider for grouping items within a tab.

To propose and apply a structure, read the room with GET /rooms/{roomId}, add tabs and sections, then move and reorder items.

Workspace API keys always need `rooms:write`. Adding a document or either form of URL also needs `documents:write`; section and embed items do not.
